doc: The memory schema in Postgres, one revision (decision D193): the bot_memory, bot_behavior (with its lifetime: a turn behavior or a persistent routine), bot_behavior_trigger, bot_stm_memory and bot_stm_turn tables, the people long-term memory holds (bot_person; bot_person_embedding, the embeddings heard for each person, kind voice; decision D194; and bot_person_centroid, each person's one representative voice, which rest reinforces; decision D205), bot_sequence (the sequences ids are taken from, person for people; decision D205), and their indexes. The defaulted created_at and updated_at are TIMESTAMPTZ DEFAULT NOW().

upgrade.sql: CREATE TABLE bot_memory (memory_id TEXT NOT NULL, scope TEXT DEFAULT 'memory' NOT NULL, context_ref TEXT, subject_ref TEXT, kind TEXT, sensitivity TEXT, retention TEXT, content TEXT NOT NULL, content_format TEXT DEFAULT 'text/plain' NOT NULL, query_tags TEXT, metadata_json TEXT DEFAULT '{}' NOT NULL, created_at TIMESTAMPTZ DEFAULT NOW() NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY (memory_id))
CREATE INDEX bot_memory_context_idx ON bot_memory (context_ref, subject_ref)
CREATE INDEX bot_memory_scope_idx ON bot_memory (scope, created_at)

CREATE TABLE bot_behavior (name TEXT NOT NULL, source TEXT NOT NULL, description TEXT DEFAULT '' NOT NULL, examples_json TEXT DEFAULT '[]' NOT NULL, status TEXT DEFAULT 'ACTIVE' NOT NULL, status_reason TEXT DEFAULT '' NOT NULL, status_updated_at TEXT DEFAULT '' NOT NULL, used_count TEXT DEFAULT '0' NOT NULL, last_used_at TEXT DEFAULT '' NOT NULL, failed_count TEXT DEFAULT '0' NOT NULL, last_failed_at TEXT DEFAULT '' NOT NULL, created_at TIMESTAMPTZ DEFAULT NOW() NOT NULL, updated_at TIMESTAMPTZ DEFAULT NOW() NOT NULL, lifetime TEXT DEFAULT 'turn' NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY (name))

CREATE TABLE bot_behavior_trigger (behavior_name TEXT NOT NULL, "trigger" TEXT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY (behavior_name, "trigger"), FOREIGN KEY(behavior_name) REFERENCES bot_behavior (name) ON DELETE CASCADE)

CREATE TABLE bot_stm_memory (stm_id TEXT NOT NULL, stimulus_name TEXT NOT NULL, payload_json TEXT DEFAULT '{}' NOT NULL, event_id TEXT, source TEXT, target TEXT, created_at TEXT NOT NULL, last_accessed_at TEXT, PRIMARY KEY (stm_id))
CREATE INDEX bot_stm_memory_recent_idx ON bot_stm_memory (stimulus_name, created_at)

CREATE TABLE bot_stm_turn (seq SERIAL NOT NULL, turn_id TEXT NOT NULL, at TEXT NOT NULL, direction TEXT NOT NULL, speakers_json TEXT DEFAULT '[]' NOT NULL, text TEXT NOT NULL, cut INTEGER DEFAULT '0' NOT NULL, conversation TEXT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY (seq))
CREATE TABLE bot_person (person_id TEXT NOT NULL, created_at TIMESTAMPTZ DEFAULT NOW() NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY (person_id))

CREATE TABLE bot_person_embedding (seq SERIAL NOT NULL, person_id TEXT NOT NULL, kind TEXT NOT NULL, embedding TEXT NOT NULL, created_at TIMESTAMPTZ DEFAULT NOW() NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY (seq), FOREIGN KEY(person_id) REFERENCES bot_person (person_id) ON DELETE CASCADE)
CREATE INDEX bot_person_embedding_person_idx ON bot_person_embedding (kind, person_id, seq)

CREATE TABLE bot_person_centroid (person_id TEXT NOT NULL, kind TEXT NOT NULL, centroid TEXT NOT NULL, weight BIGINT NOT NULL, first_seq BIGINT NOT NULL, through_seq BIGINT NOT NULL, updated_at TIMESTAMPTZ DEFAULT NOW() NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY (person_id, kind), FOREIGN KEY(person_id) REFERENCES bot_person (person_id) ON DELETE CASCADE)
CREATE INDEX bot_person_centroid_kind_idx ON bot_person_centroid (kind, first_seq)
CREATE TABLE bot_sequence (name TEXT NOT NULL, value BIGINT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY (name))
